approval.description: draft until it is issued or asked for; awaiting_approval while a request to issue it waits; approved once issued; rejected when the latest request was rejected and it is still a draft.

delivery.description: From its latest email (FR-AR-06): not_sent until emailInvoice sends it; then sent, delivered, or bounced when the provider refused or returned it; viewed (the customer first opened its secure link) comes with the online link.

due.description: overdue once its due date has passed while it is issued and not paid in full; not_due otherwise.

ledger.description: not_posted, posted (issued), or voided by a reversal.

settlement.description: What is settled of it, from the receipts, credits and write-offs applied to it net of their voids (FR-AR-18): open, part_paid, paid, or written_off when it is settled and a write-off settles part of it (FR-AR-17). A credit note: open, part_applied or applied, by what is applied to invoices or refunded of it (FR-AR-04).
